capabilities.capability: Bullpen roster, handedness, quality, availability, and workload
capabilities.evidence: Current selected inputs retain recent-bullpen-workload missing indicators; no reliever selection/availability contract exists.

capabilities.capability: V18 batter/pitcher features for hypothetical PAs
capabilities.evidence: Five saved fold pipelines expect 246 raw inputs that create 273 treatment inputs; the existing game adapter is fixed to the older 234-feature contract and no V18 prospective template authority exists.
capabilities.implication: Saved V18 OOF models cannot legally be driven through a full simulated game.

capabilities.evidence: whole_game_monte_carlo.py maintains and validates these simulated fields; V18 includes the five model state inputs.

capabilities.capability: Historical PA outcome and pre/post-PA base/out state
capabilities.evidence: Registered FD1 play_transition partitions provide explicit Retrosheet-ordered before/after states through 2025. Current Gold has opaque, non-order-bearing PA keys for 2025-2026 and is not hash-sorted.
capabilities.implication: Supports exact transition fitting through fold 4 training and complete validation only for folds 1-3; 2026 authority is missing.

capabilities.capability: Runner advancement conditional on outcome/base-out state
capabilities.evidence: FD1 explicit after-state targets are used with fold-local Dirichlet smoothing and governed backoff. They are retrospective targets, never pregame features.
capabilities.implication: Transition artifacts are executable for four training folds; evaluation is complete for folds 1-3 only.

capabilities.capability: Double plays, sacrifices, errors within a PA
capabilities.evidence: They are represented only through the coarse eight-class outcome and empirical resulting transition, not distinct mechanisms.
capabilities.implication: Transition uncertainty is retained; no specialist added.

capabilities.capability: Steals, caught stealing, wild pitches, passed balls, pickoffs between PAs
capabilities.evidence: The PA-step engine has no governed between-PA event clock/provider.
capabilities.implication: Baseline cannot model these events explicitly.

capabilities.capability: Starter workload, fatigue, times through order, removal

capabilities.implication: Do not silently hold a starter for a qualified V18 baseline.
